name: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Yadagirigutta
scope: The upper shrine and gateway core of the rebuilt Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple at Yadagirigutta in Telangana, as opened in March 2022 with its later gilded vimana.
era: Standing temple following the 2022 reopening and gilding

stories.title: Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple, Yadagirigutta

review.notes: Started with the published Qualla inventory and compared the exact public-domain 2009 original. It predates the rebuilt temple. The story hero depicts a different temple and the current photographs have nonqualifying licenses. Used written witness measurements and native map and terrain data.
